en.description:
Gamebox is a lightweight mini-game collection that supports iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch all at once. Whether you're killing time on your phone, enjoying a larger screen on your iPad, or squeezing in a quick round on your watch, you can open it anytime and jump right in.

The app features a variety of classic mini-games, including 2048, Snake, Brick Breaker, Stick Pin, Tower Builder, and a baking idle game. Each game is optimized for different devices: iPhone and iPad offer a more spacious control experience, while the Apple Watch version keeps rounds short, responsive, and perfect for quick pick-up-and-play moments.

One app, play anywhere. Whether you're commuting, taking a break, or just glancing at your wrist, there's always a game ready for the moment.

The collection currently includes 32 mini-games:
Rogue Spirit
Life Restart
Jump
Tarot
Truth or Dare
Brave Adventure
Starfighter
Air Pistol
Sheep a Sheep
Fall Down

2048

Hoop Shoot
Alchemist: Water Sort


Upgrade to Premium to unlock unlimited access to all features with no ads.
Subscriptions are available Monthly And Yearly.

Payment will be charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription auto-renews at the end of each term unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to period end. You can manage and cancel in Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current period; you’ll keep Premium access until then and will revert to the free version afterward.

zh.description:
游戏合集是一款同时支持 iPhone、iPad 和 Apple Watch 的轻量小游戏盒子。无论是在手机上休闲娱乐、在 iPad 上大屏畅玩，还是在手表上快速来一局，都能随时打开、轻松上手。
应用内收录多款经典小游戏，包括 2048、贪吃蛇、打砖块、见缝插针、盖楼挑战和烘焙放置玩法。每款游戏都针对不同设备进行了适配：手机和 iPad 提供更舒展的操作空间，Apple Watch 则保留短局、快速反馈和随手可玩的节奏。
一个应用，多端畅玩。通勤路上、休息间隙、抬腕片刻，都能找到适合当下的一局小游戏。

目前收录 32 款小游戏：
精灵肉鸽 
人生重开模拟器
